messages:
olga: Heads-up: PM has approved sunsetting the legacy `X-Routing-Hint` header. Targeting ~6 weeks. Need a combined plan covering console signals, SDK shims (py/ts/go), telemetry, and quota continuity.
mike: big +1. quota continuity is the tricky part - we key buckets by header value today. We need aliasing or we'll disrupt billing.
prasanna: Console UX idea: add a "Routing compatibility" admin panel that lists affected keys, lets admins accept auto-mappings, and can export a CSV for support outreach. No user-facing toasts; admin-only banners.
evan: SDKs: propose a 3-release shim: release N adds adapter & startup deprecation warning, N+1 keeps adapter but adds opt-out via config/env, N+2 flips default off. Also provide a one-line opt-back-in ENV var for customers.
mike: telemetry: add `routing.hint.mode` dimension with values `legacy_header`,`shim_injected`,`explicit_policy`,`none`. Also add `sdk.lang` + `sdk.version` to events to detect proxy rewrites.
olga: console: can we surface a small dashboard tile showing top 10 legacy header values and week-over-week trend? that'll help comms prioritize.
prasanna: yes, once the dimension exists we can build the tile. we should also include a "suspected_proxy_rewrite" column in the CSV derived from mismatch heuristics.
evan: python specifics: v2.5.0 will include adapter that copies header -> new payload and emits DeprecationWarning on import. v2.6.0 will set default off. env var `RW_ROUTE_LEGACY=1` to force legacy. Log a single warning only to avoid spam.
mike: TS specifics: maintain types. export Client config `{ routingCompat?: boolean }` default true initially. Use `console.warn` in browsers and `process.emitWarning` in node. Provide a `--force-legacy` CLI flag for SEs.
prasanna: Go specifics: no runtime DeprecationWarning. Add `log.Warnf` and metric `redwood_routing_compat{mode="legacy"}` + `/debug/routing` endpoint showing current compat mode for scraping.
olga: quotas: suggest alias reads to both old and new keys for 45 days, write-through to new key only, then run a reconcile to merge counters. Billing needs an audit log of the aliasing.
mike: ingestion team: please run a bounded backfill (30d) to capture historical usage of legacy header so we have baselines. storage budget is OK.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: feature/route-hint-sunset -> canary 2024-06-10 03:30 UTC :calendar:
prasanna: edge-case: some customers have proxies that normalize headers. Heuristic: if sdk.version >= shim_release && routing.hint.mode == "legacy_header" then flag suspected_proxy_rewrite. Include that flag in CSV.
evan: devex asks: add an opt-in `simulateNewPolicy` flag in SDK CLIs for SEs to validate before flipping defaults. Add unit tests to assert `routing.hint.mode` dimension emitted correctly for each code path.
olga: docs: include Envoy/nginx snippets that either strip the header or rewrite it into the new payload, plus rollback examples. Also include a migration snippet for cloud-managed proxies.
mike: timeline draft: Week 0 announce + docs; Week 1 telemetry + dashboard + backfill; Weeks 2-5 SDK releases (py/ts/go); Week 6 flip defaults off in SDKs; Week 9 router stops accepting legacy header with a 2-week rollback window.
prasanna: Support CSV columns: tenant_id, api_key_hash, legacy_value, mapped_policy_preview, suspected_proxy_rewrite, owner_contact.
olga: I'll own comms + migration guide. creating checklist and assigning owners. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
